`abstract class ShaderProgram`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BlurShader`](/reference/shaders/blurshader/), [`BorderShader`](/reference/shaders/bordershader/), [`CircleShader`](/reference/shaders/circleshader/), [`GradientShader`](/reference/shaders/gradientshader/), [`RoundedShader`](/reference/shaders/roundedshader/), [`ShadowShader`](/reference/shaders/shadowshader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderProgram.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/ShaderProgram.java)

Base class of a shader of your own, loaded from JOID GLSL sources and created on the render bridge the first time it is used.

## Description

Extend it with a singleton, load the sources in the constructor, and draw through `use` so that the previous shader and blending come back afterwards:

```java fragment
private InvertShader() {
	super.load("shaders/invert.vsh", "shaders/invert.fsh");
}
```

A source that cannot be read or compiled warns once and makes the shader unavailable: what it draws is skipped instead of failing the frame.
Create and use it on the render thread.

<a id="ShaderProgram-method-use"></a>

### use

`void use(Runnable bind, Runnable body)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Runs `bind`, which binds the shader and sets its uniforms, then `body`, which draws; then unbinds the shader and restores the previous shader and blending, even when `body` throws.
Does nothing when the shader is unavailable.

<a id="ShaderProgram-method-uniformGradient"></a>

### uniformGradient

`void uniformGradient(IShader shader, ColorGradient gradient, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Sets `u_HasGradient` to 1 and the gradient uniforms of `shader` from `gradient`, spread over the box `x1`, `y1`, `x2`, `y2`.

`void uniformGradient(IShader shader, Point startPoint, Point endPoint, Color startColor, Color endColor, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Sets the gradient uniforms of `shader` (`u_GradientStart`, `u_GradientEnd`, `u_GradientStartPos`, `u_GradientEndPos`, `u_GradientCanvas`) from two stops and two points on 1, resolving animated colors, spread over the box `x1`, `y1`, `x2`, `y2`.

<a id="ShaderProgram-method-load"></a>

### load

`void load(Object vertexShader, Object fragmentShader)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Reads the vertex and fragment sources from anything [`Asset.of`](/reference/resources/asset/#Asset-factory-of) accepts; the shader is created later, at its first use.
A source that cannot be read warns with the cause and leaves the shader unavailable.
